verdicts.question: Is the cable routing in the site photos continuous and consistent across the documented run — from rooftop panels to DCDB to inverter to ACDB to solar meter to main panel — with no orphan ends, no unexplained mid-run size changes, and visible conduit / cable-tie / clipping where the run is exposed?

verdicts.photo_observation: Tracing the AC cable (purple overlay line) across pages 9-13: it exits the roof through a hole in the chajja overhang (page 10), continues to the 'Solar Meter & Accessories' wall location (pages 10, 13), runs down the exterior wall in two further segments (page 11), continues down the side alley (pages 9, 12), and terminates at the highlighted 'Main Meter' location in the shared meter panel (pages 12-13). The LA/earthing cable (orange/green lines) separately routes down to the DC Earth Pit and LA Pit in the corridor (page 14).
